args.sql:
SELECT 
    df.RecordRegistry AS flow_id,
    df.AuditCompliancePressure,
    (CURRENT_DATE - aac.RemedDue) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    DataFlow df
JOIN 
    AuditAndCompliance aac ON df.RecordRegistry = aac.RecordRegistry
WHERE 
    (CURRENT_DATE - aac.RemedDue) BETWEEN -5 AND 0
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue ASC
LIMIT 10;
